data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Ivan Poupyrev, Brandon Barbello, Leonardo Giusti, Jaime Lien, and Nicholas Gillian. The target has raised $13M to date. The broader AI & Software sector comprises 16 known peers, including 1 public company (Palantir) and 8 private firms such as Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI. However, a narrow peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or valuation-comparable datapoints within the sector.

Given data constraints, Stage-Progression analysis is the primary applicable method. Using $13M in total capital raised as a proxy baseline value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $32M. This single-method triangulation lacks the cross-validation of a multi-method approach, limiting confidence in precision.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $28M (low) to $37M (high), with a median of $32M. The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficient same-stage or valuation-tier peer comparables in AI & Software, which prevents calibration against transaction multiples or market benchmarks. A second financing round with disclosed terms, or identification of additional early-stage AI software comparables, would materially improve conviction in any derived valuation.
